entries.title: Psalms 52:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician: an instruction. Of David; when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said unto him, David came to the house of Ahimelech.>> Why boastest thou thyself in evil, thou mighty man? The loving-kindness of *God [abideth] continually.

entries.title: Psalms 52:2
segments: Thy tongue deviseth mischievous things, like a sharp razor, practising deceit.

entries.title: Psalms 52:3
segments: Thou hast loved evil rather than good, lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 52:4
segments: Thou hast loved all devouring words, O deceitful tongue!

entries.title: Psalms 52:5
segments: *God shall likewise destroy thee for ever; he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of [thy] tent, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 52:6
segments: ¶The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him, [saying,]

entries.title: Psalms 52:7
segments: Behold the man that made not God his strength, but put confidence in the abundance of his riches, [and] strengthened himself in his avarice.

entries.title: Psalms 52:8
segments: But as for me, I am like a green olive-tree in the house of God: I will confide in the loving-kindness of God for ever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 52:9
segments: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done [it]; and I will wait on thy name, before thy godly ones, for it is good.
